# Schematic connection list (generated by schematic_netlist.py)

The KiCad schematic is generated from this list by kicad/make_kicad.py. Net names VIN, VOUT, GND, SW are required by PCB-Checker; add `VOUT_C` to
`nets.output` and `VIN_RTN` handling is already in `pcb_checker.json`. DNP = footprint only.
IC pin numbers were checked against the datasheets on 16 Nov 2026 (kicad/footprints.md).

## 1 Input and reverse polarity protection

| Ref | Value | Connections (pin → net) | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| J1 | Input 20-48V | 1 → VIN, 2 → VIN_RTN | generic part, chosen by price (16 Nov); check pitch, pin size and current rating of the part that is bought; 4.7 A at 20 V and 90 W |
| Q3 | BSC040N10NS5 | S → GND, G → RP_GATE, D → VIN_RTN | source to board GND, drain to the negative input terminal |
| R1 | 100k | 1 → VIN, 2 → RP_GATE |  |
| D3 | 12V zener | K → RP_GATE, A → GND |  |
| C1 | 100nF 50V | 1 → RP_GATE, 2 → GND |  |
| R2 (DNP) | 0R 2512 | 1 → VIN_RTN, 2 → GND | DNP: bypass of Q3 |
| R3 (DNP) | 0R 2512 | 1 → VIN_RTN, 2 → GND | DNP: bypass of Q3 (second in parallel) |
| C2 | 4.7uF 100V | 1 → VIN, 2 → GND | C2, C3 within 5 mm of Q1 drain / Q2 source; C6, C7 may stay unpopulated at first |
| C3 | 4.7uF 100V | 1 → VIN, 2 → GND |  |
| C4 | 4.7uF 100V | 1 → VIN, 2 → GND |  |
| C5 | 4.7uF 100V | 1 → VIN, 2 → GND |  |
| C6 | 4.7uF 100V | 1 → VIN, 2 → GND |  |
| C7 | 4.7uF 100V | 1 → VIN, 2 → GND |  |
| C8 | 100uF 100V | + → VIN, - → CBULK_N | can is 12.5 mm (distributor data), not 10 mm; 0.18 ohm impedance and 0.67 A ripple at 100 kHz (distributor data): confirm in the Panasonic datasheet |
| R4 | 0R 2512 | 1 → CBULK_N, 2 → GND | replace by 0.22-0.33 ohm if the bulk capacitor ESR is below 0.2 ohm |

## 4 Output shunt and current-limit (CC) loop

| Ref | Value | Connections (pin → net) | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| RSH1 | 3mR 2512 2W | 1 → VOUT_C, 2 → VOUT | Kelvin to U2 |
| J2 | Output 12V | 1 → VOUT, 2 → GND | generic part, chosen by price (16 Nov); check pitch, pin size and current rating of the part that is bought; 7.75 A in current limit, 10 A for 3 ms |
| U2 | INA180A2 | 1 OUT → ISENSE, 2 GND → GND, 3 IN+ → VOUT_C, 4 IN- → VOUT, 5 VS → +5V_CC | pinout A version; common mode -0.2..26 V |
| C28 | 100nF 50V | 1 → +5V_CC, 2 → GND | at U2 |
| U3 | MCP6001 | 1 OUT → CC_OUT, 2 VSS → GND, 3 IN+ → VREF_CC, 4 IN- → CC_INV, 5 VDD → +5V_CC | standard pinout (not the R or U variant) |
| C29 | 100nF 50V | 1 → +5V_CC, 2 → GND | at U3 |
| R23 | 20k | 1 → ISENSE, 2 → CC_INV | integrator R |
| C30 | 100nF 50V | 1 → CC_INV, 2 → CC_OUT | integrator C (tau 2 ms) |
| D2 | 1N4148W | A → CC_OUT, K → CC_INV |  |
| D1 | 1N4148W | A → CC_D, K → CC_OUT |  |
| R24 | 220R | 1 → CC_LINK, 2 → CC_D |  |
| R25 | 0R | 1 → ITH, 2 → CC_LINK | CC enable link: remove to disable the current-limit loop |
| U4 | TL431A | 1 K → +5V_CC, 2 REF → V5_FB, 3 A → GND | DBZ pinout: 1 cathode, 2 ref, 3 anode; needs >= 4.7 uF on the rail (C33) for stability, see calc/t12b_cc_supply.py |
| R29 | 820R | 1 → DRVCC, 2 → +5V_CC | series resistor of the shunt regulator: 6.1 mA at DRVCC 10 V, >= 1 mA left for the TL431 at 7.0 V |
| R26 | 10k 0.1% | 1 → +5V_CC, 2 → V5_FB | sets the 5 V rail together with R30 (equal values) |
| R30 | 10k 0.1% | 1 → V5_FB, 2 → GND |  |
| R27 | 22k | 1 → +5V_CC, 2 → TRIM_HI | threshold divider top |
| RV1 | 5k 25-turn | 1 → TRIM_HI, 2 → VREF_CC, 3 → TRIM_LO | threshold 4.2-9.6 A nominal (0.22 A per turn) |
| R28 | 3k9 | 1 → TRIM_LO, 2 → GND | threshold divider bottom |
| C31 | 100nF 50V | 1 → VREF_CC, 2 → GND |  |
| C33 | 10uF 25V 1206 | 1 → +5V_CC, 2 → GND | 5 V rail; also the TL431 stability capacitor: never leave it out |
